methods.summary: Uses driver.wait_for_object() pattern to verify UI element presence with configurable timeout and exception handling

summaries.summary: HpxShortcuts is a UI page class for Android Smart app automation that extends SmartFlow base class. It provides methods for verifying and interacting with the HPX Shortcuts screen. The class uses Selenium WebDriver patterns with explicit waits, timeout handling, and exception management (TimeoutException, NoSuchElementException, StaleElementReferenceException). The implementation follows a page object model pattern with wait-based verification methods for UI elements. The flow_name attribute identifies this as the 'hpx_shortcuts' flow for test organization and reporting purposes.
